assertions.assertion: CPT code 93226 represents a 48-hour Holter monitoring study
The claim was denied under Reason Code CO-22
The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and intermittent lightheadedness
The patient has a history of unspecified cardiac arrhythmia (I49.9)
The diagnosis of paroxysmal atrial fibrillation (I48.0) supports the need to capture potential arrhythmic events over 48 hours
The denial is based on coordination of benefits protocols indicating care may be covered by another payer
